product.description: Monoprice™Cat6A 1ft Black Flexible TPE Outdoor Patch CableUTP, 24AWG, 500 MHz, Pure Bare Copper, Snagless RJ45, Flex Series Ethernet CableMonoprice™ Cat6A Flex TPE Ethernet Network Patch Cable is ultra-flexible and made with a TPE compound sheath. It can withstand continuous flexing from motion applications used in the automotive, transportation, or robotics industries. The superior high-frequency characteristics and 10-GB data transmission rates of the Cat6A CM cable passed the DSX-8000 Fluke channel test @ 500 MHz and guarantee excellent performance. The durable wire offers an oil-resistant and UV-resistant jacket with a temperature range of -40 °F to 176 °F and is ideally used for industrial or outdoor environments.
